# blender-scene-setup

Set up and audit Blender scenes the way studios do: metric units at real-world scale, a per-asset collection layout, Unreal-style naming (SM_, SK_, T_, M_), origins set for props, characters and hinges, linking versus appending and library overrides, asset libraries and catalogs, and an audit script that flags unapplied scale, default names, root-level objects, orphans and image-path problems before handoff or export.
